turns.user: I have a valid monthly Budapest pass. What else do I need to use 100E?
turns.agent:
If yours is the regular monthly Budapest pass, the snapshot says you can use 100E by adding a separate 1,000 HUF airport shuttle add-on ticket for one 100E trip. The add-on is bought in BudapestGO; it does not cover transfers to other routes. The regular monthly pass itself is not enough for 100E.

Two exceptions matter: the 15-day Budapest pass and the monthly pass for job seekers do not qualify for this add-on. If “monthly Budapest pass” means a different product, tell me its exact name and I can narrow this down. These details are from the 5 November 2026 snapshot; check BKK’s current add-on airport shuttle bus single ticket information before travelling. I can explain the alternative full-price 100E ticket too, if useful.

links.text: add-on airport shuttle bus single ticket

turns.user: Does the 1,000 HUF add-on also cover a connecting tram after I leave 100E?
turns.agent: No. The 1,000 HUF 100E add-on covers one trip on 100E only; it does not cover a connecting tram or another route. For that onward ride, use your valid monthly Budapest pass. See BKK’s add-on airport shuttle bus single ticket page. This is based on the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not a live check.
